headline: Saturday carried the weekend; Sunday's $493 was the thinnest in eight weeks
commentary:
### The weekend
- **$7,418 NP over the two days**, under last weekend but well ahead of normal.
  - NP: $7,418 v $9,287 last weekend
  - 4-weekend average NP: $5,081
- Margin held near 20% because we bought a lot less traffic, cheaper.
  - Cost: $29,836 v $34,768
  - Search CPC: $11.52 v $13.41
- Saturday did all the work. Sunday more or less washed its face.
  - Sun NP: $493 at 3.5% NM
  - 8-Sunday average NP: $3,555
### Friday
- Fri 02/10 came in just shy of the previous Friday, on less spend.
  - NP: $8,850 v $9,616 on 25/09
  - Cost: $38,389 v $40,574
- Cheaper clicks, more of them, and lead value gave some back.
  - Search clicks: 2,736 v 2,411
  - Search EPL: $29.86 v $34.06
### What drove it
- Sunday was a lead value day, not a traffic day.
  - EPL: $11.07 v $14.53 last Sun
  - 8-Sunday EPL range: $11.06-$17.63
- Search clicks held up but turned into fewer leads than last week.
  - Search leads: 440 v 550
  - Clicks: 1,030 v 1,115
- The heavy evening hours, where the clicks sit, paid badly all night.
  - 19:00 EPL: $15.21 on 99 clicks
  - 21:00 EPL: $42.87 on 84 clicks
- Test tree ran light on Sunday; the direct side was fine.
  - Test tree EPL: $21.02 v $24.25 last 7
  - Direct (Inc ZP) EPL: $26.33
### Tests
| Test | Set-up | Spend 04/10 | Spend wk ago | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| competitor | tROAS, no SA | $642 | $1,110 | — |
| personal | tROAS, no SA | $303 | $790 | — |
| speed | high tROAS, stepping down | $131 | $670 | — |
| scavengers | cheap-click pickup | $536 | — | — |
- Speed stays small on purpose while the target comes down a rung at a time.
  - Speed clicks: 9 v 43 last Sun
- The scavengers ran through the weekend and bought clicks at a fraction of search.
  - competitor_scavenger CPC: $2.62 v $13.96 on competitor
watch: Sunday EPL at $11.07 sat on the floor of the eight-week range, so we're tracking whether next weekend comes back toward $14.66.
Search EPL month-to-date is $28.32 against $24.99 on Sunday; a second weak weekday would make it more than lumpiness.
cash_advance is taking more spend at $16.18 CPC against $14.47 a week ago, and we're following what that buys.
